_readme: Dates we are offering other bands. Edit here or at /dates-admin.html. A date with "status": "open" shows on /play-with-us.html and can be claimed; "filled" stays visible with the bill on it so nobody asks twice; "past" and anything before today drop off on their own.

_fields.id: short slug, must be unique — used in the confirmation email
_fields.venue: room name, or "TBD" if it is not locked yet
_fields.slot: what is actually on offer — "one support slot", "two openers", "a bill to build"
_fields.note: anything a band needs to know before saying yes — pay split, backline, curfew
_fields.filled_by: who took it, once it is gone
